items.reason: This is the adapalene gel you asked for, and nothing in your answers conflicts with it, so it stays as a night step for a clearer-looking complexion.
Adapalene can leave skin more sensitive to sun, so a daily mineral SPF 50 is needed alongside it.
A light ceramide moisturizer helps offset dryness from the gel, which suits your lower moisture score.
A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps the routine simple and avoids stacking extra irritation on top of the gel.

response.routine_note: Cleanse and apply SPF in the morning, then at night cleanse, apply a pea-sized amount of gel to dry skin and follow with moisturizer, starting every second or third night. I kept the routine small and added no other exfoliating acids or retinols, since they could irritate when combined with adapalene.
